import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:dio/dio.dart';
import 'package:felorx_api_client/felorx_api_client.dart';

void check(bool value, String message) {
  if (!value) throw StateError(message);
}

Future<void> rejects(
  Future<void> Function() action,
  bool Function(Object) match,
) async {
  try {
    await action();
  } catch (error) {
    if (match(error)) return;
    rethrow;
  }
  throw StateError('Expected failure');
}

Future<void> main() async {
  // Feed every UTF-8 byte separately, including split CRLF, BOM, comments,
  // multiline data, ignored fields, and event names inferred from JSON.
  final wire =
      '\uFEFF:keepalive\r\nid: ignored\r\n'
      'event: response.output_text.delta\r\n'
      'data: {"type":"response.output_text.delta",\r\n'
      'data: "delta":"你好"}\r\n\r\n'
      'data: {"type":"response.completed","response":{"status":"completed"}}\r\n\r\n';
  final events = await decodeFelorxResponseStream(
    Stream.fromIterable(utf8.encode(wire).map((byte) => [byte])),
  ).toList();
  check(
    events.length == 2 &&
        events.first.data['delta'] == '你好' &&
        events.last.isTerminal,
    'Split SSE framing',
  );
  for (final invalid in [
    'data: {"type":"response.created"}\n\n',
    'event: response.completed\ndata: {"type":"response.failed"}\n\n',
    'data: []\n\n',
    'data: [DONE]\n\n',
    'data: {"type":"response.completed"}\n',
  ]) {
    await rejects(() async {
      await decodeFelorxResponseStream(
        Stream.value(utf8.encode(invalid)),
      ).toList();
    }, (e) => e is FormatException);
  }
  await rejects(() async {
    await decodeFelorxResponseStream(
      Stream.value(List.filled(65, 97)),
      maxEventCharacters: 64,
    ).toList();
  }, (e) => e is FormatException);
  await rejects(() async {
    await decodeFelorxResponseStream(Stream.value([0xff])).toList();
  }, (e) => e is FormatException);

  final server = await HttpServer.bind(InternetAddress.loopbackIPv4, 0);
  final received = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
  final paths = <String>[];
  final hanging = <HttpResponse>[];
  final started = <String, Completer<void>>{};
  final serverErrors = <Object>[];
  server.listen((request) async {
    try {
      check(
        request.headers.value('authorization') == 'Bearer sdk-test-token',
        'Bearer auth missing',
      );
      check(
        request.headers.value('X-Felorx-Ai-Provider') == 'test-provider',
        'Provider header missing',
      );
      final body =
          jsonDecode(await utf8.decoder.bind(request).join())
              as Map<String, dynamic>;
      received.add(body);
      paths.add(request.uri.path);
      final mode = body['input'] as String;
      started[mode]?.complete();
      if (mode == 'json') {
        request.response.headers.contentType = ContentType.json;
        request.response.write(
          jsonEncode({
            'id': 'resp_test',
            'object': 'response',
            'status': 'completed',
            'output': [],
          }),
        );
        await request.response.close();
        return;
      }
      check(body['stream'] == true, 'Stream flag missing');
      check(
        request.headers.value('accept') == 'text/event-stream',
        'SSE accept missing',
      );
      if (mode == 'before-headers') {
        hanging.add(request.response);
        return;
      }
      if (mode == 'quota') {
        request.response.statusCode = 429;
        request.response.headers.contentType = ContentType.json;
        request.response.write('{"error":{"code":"quota_exceeded"}}');
        await request.response.close();
        return;
      }
      if (mode == 'wrong-content-type') {
        request.response.headers.contentType = ContentType.json;
        request.response.write('{}');
        await request.response.close();
        return;
      }
      if (mode == 'slow')
        await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(seconds: 4));
      request.response.headers.contentType = ContentType(
        'text',
        'event-stream',
        charset: 'utf-8',
      );
      request.response.bufferOutput = false;
      request.response.write('data: {"type":"response.created"}\n\n');
      await request.response.flush();
      if (mode == 'cancel' || mode == 'token-cancel') {
        hanging.add(request.response);
        return;
      }
      if (mode == 'truncated') {
        await request.response.close();
        return;
      }
      if (mode == 'stream-error') {
        request.response.write(
          'event: error\ndata: {"error":{"code":"upstream_failed"}}\n\n',
        );
      } else {
        for (final byte in utf8.encode(wire)) {
          request.response.add([byte]);
        }
      }
      await request.response.close();
    } catch (error) {
      serverErrors.add(error);
    }
  });
  final client = FelorxApiClient(
    basePathOverride: 'http://127.0.0.1:${server.port}',
  );
  client.setBearerAuth('FelorxBearer', 'sdk-test-token');
  final requestTokens = <String, CancelToken>{};
  client.dio.interceptors.add(
    InterceptorsWrapper(
      onRequest: (options, handler) {
        final input =
            (jsonDecode(options.data as String) as Map)['input'] as String;
        if (options.cancelToken != null)
          requestTokens[input] = options.cancelToken!;
        handler.next(options);
      },
    ),
  );
  final api = client.getResponsesApi();
  Stream<FelorxResponseStreamEvent> stream(String mode, {CancelToken? token}) =>
      api.createResponseStream(
        felorxResponsesCreateRequest: FelorxResponsesCreateRequest(input: mode),
        xFelorxAiProvider: 'test-provider',
        cancelToken: token,
      );
  try {
    final json = await api.createResponse(
      felorxResponsesCreateRequest: FelorxResponsesCreateRequest(input: 'json'),
      xFelorxAiProvider: 'test-provider',
    );
    check(json.data?.id == 'resp_test', 'Normal JSON authentication/decoding');
    await rejects(() async {
      await api.createResponse(
        felorxResponsesCreateRequest: FelorxResponsesCreateRequest(
          stream: true,
        ),
      );
    }, (e) => e is ArgumentError);
    final request = FelorxResponsesCreateRequest(input: 'ok', stream: false);
    final rawRequest = <String, dynamic>{
      'input': 'raw',
      'stream': false,
      'include': ['reasoning.encrypted_content'],
      'provider_extension': {'enabled': true},
    };
    await api
        .createResponseRawStream(
          body: rawRequest,
          xFelorxAiProvider: 'test-provider',
        )
        .toList();
    check(
      rawRequest['stream'] == false &&
          received.last['stream'] == true &&
          received.last['include'][0] == 'reasoning.encrypted_content' &&
          received.last['provider_extension']['enabled'] == true,
      'Raw request extension fields lost or caller body mutated',
    );
    final result = await api
        .createResponseStream(
          felorxResponsesCreateRequest: request,
          xFelorxAiProvider: 'test-provider',
        )
        .toList()
        .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 10));
    check(
      request.stream == false && result.length == 3 && result.last.isTerminal,
      'Stream completion or request mutation',
    );
    await api
        .createResponseLegacyStream(
          felorxResponsesCreateRequest: request,
          xFelorxAiProvider: 'test-provider',
        )
        .toList();
    check(
      paths.contains('/api/ai/v1/responses') &&
          paths.contains('/api/ai/openai/responses'),
      'Route aliases',
    );
    check(
      (await stream(
        'slow',
      ).toList().timeout(const Duration(seconds: 10))).last.isTerminal,
      'Stream inherited the 3-second JSON timeout',
    );
    final errors = await stream('stream-error').toList();
    check(
      errors.last.type == 'error' &&
          errors.last.data['error']['code'] == 'upstream_failed',
      'In-stream error lost',
    );
    await rejects(
      () async {
        await stream('quota').toList();
      },
      (e) =>
          e is DioException &&
          e.response?.statusCode == 429 &&
          (e.response?.data as Map)['error']['code'] == 'quota_exceeded',
    );
    await rejects(() async {
      await stream('truncated').toList();
    }, (e) => e is FormatException);
    await rejects(() async {
      await stream('wrong-content-type').toList();
    }, (e) => e is FormatException);

    final parent = CancelToken();
    final first = Completer<void>();
    final subscription = stream('cancel', token: parent).listen((_) {
      if (!first.isCompleted) first.complete();
    });
    await first.future.timeout(const Duration(seconds: 5));
    print('Checking subscription cancellation');
    await subscription.cancel().timeout(const Duration(seconds: 5));
    check(
      !parent.isCancelled,
      'Subscription cancellation cancelled caller token',
    );
    check(
      requestTokens['cancel']!.isCancelled && requestTokens['cancel'] != parent,
      'Owned request token was not cancelled',
    );

    final token = CancelToken();
    print('Checking caller token cancellation');
    final tokenFirst = Completer<void>();
    final tokenError = Completer<Object>();
    final tokenSubscription = stream('token-cancel', token: token).listen(
      (_) {
        if (!tokenFirst.isCompleted) tokenFirst.complete();
      },
      onError: (Object e) {
        if (!tokenError.isCompleted) tokenError.complete(e);
      },
    );
    await tokenFirst.future.timeout(const Duration(seconds: 5));
    token.cancel();
    check(
      await tokenError.future.timeout(const Duration(seconds: 5))
          is DioException,
      'Caller token did not abort stream',
    );
    await tokenSubscription.cancel();

    started['before-headers'] = Completer<void>();
    print('Checking cancellation before headers');
    final pending = stream(
      'before-headers',
    ).listen((_) => throw StateError('Unexpected event'));
    await started['before-headers']!.future.timeout(const Duration(seconds: 5));
    await pending.cancel().timeout(const Duration(seconds: 2));
    check(
      requestTokens['before-headers']!.isCancelled,
      'Pending HTTP request was not cancelled',
    );
    check(serverErrors.isEmpty, 'HTTP fixture failed: $serverErrors');
    print(
      'Responses SSE framing, HTTP auth, aliases, errors and cancellation passed',
    );
  } catch (error, stack) {
    stderr.writeln('Responses stream fixture failed: $error\n$stack');
    rethrow;
  } finally {
    client.dio.close(force: true);
    await server.close(force: true);
  }
}
